features.name: Authentication
features.description: Sign-in and sign-up flow using Convex Auth with email/password. Shows sign-in form for unauthenticated users and redirects authenticated users to dashboard or home.

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Marketing-style landing page shown to authenticated users at /home with feature showcase and call-to-action sections.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main role-based dashboard for authenticated users showing different views for owners, mechanics, and admins.

features.name: Vessel Management
features.description: Add, view, and manage vessels with QR codes. Each vessel gets a unique QR code for maintenance tracking.

features.name: Equipment Manifest
features.description: Comprehensive equipment tracking with 15 categories including service intervals, warranty, and condition monitoring.

features.name: Work Orders
features.description: Full work order lifecycle management including quote requests, quoting, approval, in-progress tracking, and completion.

features.name: Work Order Parts System
features.description: Parts tracking for work orders with autocomplete from a shared parts database.

features.name: QR Scanner
features.description: Browser-based QR code scanner for vessel identification using html5-qrcode.

features.name: Mechanic Directory
features.description: Searchable directory of marine mechanics with filters for certifications, availability, and ratings.

features.name: Mechanic Profile & Onboarding
features.description: Mechanic profile management and onboarding wizard with business details, certifications, and availability status.

features.name: Owner Profile & Onboarding
features.description: Owner profile management and onboarding flow for boat owners.

features.name: Dual Rating System
features.description: Bidirectional rating system with wrench icons for mechanic ratings and star icons for owner ratings.

features.name: Preferred Mechanics
features.description: Owners can maintain a preferred mechanics list with private notes.

features.name: Access Control & Requests
features.description: Mechanic authorization system for vessels with request/approve/deny workflow.

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Direct messaging between owners and mechanics contextual to vessels and work orders.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Comprehensive in-app notification system covering access requests, work orders, quotes, messaging, and ratings.

features.name: Help Center
features.description: In-app documentation and help guides at /help with role-based content and markdown rendering.

features.name: Announcements
features.description: Admin broadcast system for publishing role-targeted announcements with pinning and expiration.

features.name: Admin Control Panel
features.description: Admin dashboard for managing app settings, users, and system configuration.

features.name: Theme System
features.description: Dark/light mode support with glassmorphism effects and CSS custom properties.

features.name: Service History & Reminders
features.description: Track service history for vessels and equipment with scheduled maintenance reminders.

features.name: Quote System
features.description: Detailed mechanic quotes for work orders including labor, parts estimates, and completion dates.

features.name: Image Cropping
features.description: Image cropper for profile photos and vessel images with Convex storage upload.
